messages:
maria: quick sync 1: proposing a small-but-critical change to how we handle structured logs for the GPU fleet before we flip ingest-proxy v2 next week. aim: reduce egress cost, keep debugability for perf incidents, and make PII handling explicit per-tenant. TL;DR below.

kevin: ok share the TL;DR here, want to make sure this doesn't break any dashboards.

maria: TL;DR:
- unified log envelope: env, cluster, region, node_id, gpu_type, event_class, severity, trace_id, msg, meta.*
- event_class enum: controlplane | request | telemetry | billing
- sampling: deterministic per node+minute; telemetry default 1% global, controlplane regional rates (hot regions higher), request captured if severity >= ERROR
- redaction: run at producer (kafka client) with whitelist+regex; per-tenant masking for contract-bound customers
- short-term full trace buffer: 30s window stored in S3 for debug retrieval (costed + TTL)
- alert tuning: widen flapping windows and group by (cluster,node_id,gpu_type)

leo: where should model-related metadata go? e.g., model_id, quant_profile

maria: put them under meta.model_id and meta.quant_profile and only populate for request traces.

soumya: about deterministic sampling 1: i recommend hashing node_id + floor(ts/60) to avoid hot-node bias. deterministic sampling makes reconstruction of distributions easier.

kevin: agreed. also need coverage metrics added so we can see sampling impact on observability SLOs.

maria: proposed counters (prometheus): ingest_logs_total{region,cluster,node_id,event_class}, ingest_logs_sampled_total{...}, ingest_logs_dropped_total{...}. expose on /metrics from ingest-proxy.

kevin: cost estimate: moving telemetry to 1% cuts promtail->kafka egress by ~40%-50% based on current distribution. plz include in PR a delta estimate and a rollback plan.

maria: noted. rollback: ability to flip sampling rates via feature-flag + instant-escalation runbook to set telemetry=100% for a region.

leo: dashboards: add a heatmap for sampling coverage by region+node_id, a panel for sample-rate changes over time, and an annotation stream for ingest-proxy deploys and config changes.

ingest-bot: config draft uploaded to s3://redwood-configs/ingest/redaction-sampling/v2.json by maria (2026-03-17T13:22Z)

tia: regulatory note: EU contracts require client IP masking. ensure meta.client_ip is masked by default for eu regions and provide tenant-level opt-in to include raw IP when contract allows.

kevin: alert tuning proposal: retire 1m flapping alert for gpu_node_unready. New rule: alert if unready_count > 3 for 10m OR pod_restarts_per_node > 5 in 15m. reduces noise but keeps signal.

maria: also propose grouping node-level events into a single alert per node to reduce paging during cluster upgrades.

soumya: one more on redaction: use a whitelist-first approach (only allowed fields pass through), and apply regex scrub for common PII: ipv4, emails, JWT-like tokens. store patterns in config so legal can audit.

maria: example pseudo-config (for discussion only):
```
redaction_whitelist: ["env","cluster","region","node_id","gpu_type","event_class","severity","msg","trace_id","meta.*"]
pii_patterns:
  - "\\b\\d{1,3}(?:\\.\\d{1,3}){3}\\b"  # ipv4
  - "[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}"
sampling:
  telemetry: {type: deterministic, rate_percent: 1}
  controlplane: {type: deterministic, rate_by_region: {"us-east-1":10, "eu-west-1":8}}
  request: {type: severity_based, capture_if_severity_at_least: "ERROR"}
```

leo: can we also retain full kv-cache traces for 30s into a short-lived S3 bucket with a TTL and restricted IAM so we can quickly replay perf incidents?

maria: yes that is in proposal. we'll add cost line item and auto-delete after 30s.

kevin: next steps: maria put up PR for ingest-proxy config + docs, soumya to add sampling unit tests, leo to update Grafana dashboards, tia to sign off on EU IP masking rules. we'll review in infra sync on Thursday.

maria: thanks all. i'll post the PR link and a short runbook once it's ready. :thumbsup!
